div.div: When the pipeline is in this state, we now know that the next instruction should be addi x6. So, we need to clear the addi x2, addi x3, and addi x4 instructions. To do that, we can effectively assert a reset signal that's input to the IF/ID, ID/EX, and EX/ME pipeline registers -- it should be synchronous to take effect as we advance the instructions in the pipeline (effectively replacing the addi instructions with a nop).
